params.1273:
The dragon's breath burned away the ladder to the surface.

Locate another way out - the man you rescued may be able to advise you.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: The ladder in the starting room is gone, but you may be able to use the ladder in the cellar of the connected house, if you can reach it.
params.1275: You'll need to exploit a weak spot in the wall between the two cellars in order to make further progress.
params.1276: Talk to Roddeck, the man who just came out of the cupboard, to seek his input.
